text:
Sophie CSM: Quick heads-up  HarborEdge EBR booked for Wed 9:00am PT. Request: a 1-slide "micro-play" (visual flow + 3 bullets) focused on the renewal redline, plus a live action braid (one-sheet that teams can update during/after the EBR). Slides are at ~v0.4 in the drive.
Arun SE: I can own demo choreography. Recommend 1 main scenario (live stream) + 1 micro-offline fallback. Keep demos <=3m each.
Hannah AM: Need a tight renewal snapshot for the exec slide  health down 9% last month. Can someone pull the top 3 ticket reason codes and short root causes?
Kai Enablement: I'll build the live action braid and capture enablement asks + success criteria. Planning a 20-min smoke rehearsal Tue 11am PT to confirm owners and handoffs.
slides-bot: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/harboredge/ebr_v0.4  comments on slide 1 + notes.
Sophie CSM: Arun  add a single-line contingency note: "Fallback: quantized model if p95 > 300ms". Also add a tiny troubleshooting checklist (2 bullets) in the speaker notes.
Arun SE: ack. Will add step-by-step runbook bullets and an offline GIF. Also prepping a one-command smoke-check: `curl -sS https://perf.redwood/health || play_gif.sh`
Hannah AM: Quick risk breakdown I see: (1) onboarding backlog on 3 integrations, (2) missing SLA on batch ingest, (3) recent billing dispute. I'll paste a 2-line exec blurb with proposed mitigations and owners.
Kai Enablement: Action braid template: `Owner | Task | ETA | Priority | Status | Follow-up owner | Confidence | Severity`. I'll make it editable to owners, view-only for execs, and add a small "acceptance" checkbox column.
Sophie CSM: Good call. Add a column for "Escalation lane" (CS/Eng/Finance) so execs can see which team owns follow-ups. Slide polish deadline Tue 8am PT.
Arun SE: Tagging @eng-runtime for 1-2 bullets on recent perf variance to paste into slide notes. They can also add a recommended mitigation (e.g., kernel tweak or batch size change).
Hannah AM: I might miss the Tue smoke rehearsal  will upload a 90s voice note for my exec blurb and paste the risk blurb in the deck comments.
Kai Enablement: Live braid link: https://sheets.redwood.com/harboredge-ebs-braid  starting to populate rows and ping owners. Will add a short "how to update during meeting" guide in the sheet.
Sophie CSM: Also planning: 30s "current health" + 90s "roadmap ask" intro for execs. Keep the QBR strictly 20 minutes for the execs.
Arun SE: I'll bring the demo laptop, preload local fallbacks, and have a tiny script to switch to fallback if streaming lags.
Hannah AM: I'll finalize the renewal ask language and mitigation owners by EOD tomorrow.
Kai Enablement: After the rehearsal we'll triage braid rows by priority and assign SLAs (P0/P1). I'll export the top 5 P0s into a one-slide table for the exec pack.
Sophie CSM: Thanks all. Post-rehearsal, please confirm owner acknowledgements in the braid. If anyone can't make the rehearsal call them out now. :rocket:
